name: Businesspartner is one row per partner
note: Guards the grain fix. This cube used to LEFT JOIN c_bpartner_location and ad_user while declaring c_bpartner_id as its primary key, so 128,930 partners emitted 260,117 rows and any many_to_one join multiplied the fact - the Invoices view returned 14,549,714 lines against a true 114,960. If a location or contact join is ever reintroduced here, this count rises immediately.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_bpartner WHERE ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
